Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE X OF 2002
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE X OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Customs Act, 1969)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
27th February, 2002]
F. No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated
27-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Customs (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of First Schedule, Act IV of 1969

ORDINANCE X OF 2002
CUSTOMS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE X OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend the Customs Act, 1969)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
27th February, 2002]
F. No.2(I)/2002-Pub., dated
27-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of First Schedule, Act IV of 1969.---In the Customs
Act, 1969 (IV of 1969), in the First Schedule in section IV, in Chapter 17, in
heading No. 1701, against sub-heading Nos.1701.9910 and 1701, 9920 in column
(1), in column (3) for the figure "20 % " the figure "30 %
" shall be substituted.
